note: The one closed limitation catalogue of PER 2.0.0-rc1, in table order. `paths` are the field_path column; the first is the default path of a row.

limitations.raised_when: a native evaluation bundle declares no scoring profile
limitations.reason: No scoring profile was declared for this evaluation.
limitations.impact: Readiness and score-dependent release rules were not evaluated.
limitations.next_step: Declare an applicable scoring profile and re-evaluate.

limitations.reason: The archive carries no run identifier; run_id is derived from archive_sha256.
limitations.impact: Two uploads of byte-identical archives share a run_id; runs cannot be ordered in time.
limitations.next_step: Upgrade to archive schema 2 (harness mints a UUIDv4 at evaluate() start).

limitations.raised_when: a turn-scope `AGENT_SPAN` cited by a claim whose row carried a quote that is not a span of the answer (a code or gated annotation, or a semantic quote found neither exactly nor by casefold)
limitations.reason: The citing claim's quote is not a span of this answer; the whole answer is cited.
limitations.impact: The ref shows what the agent said on turn {turn} but does not point at the sentence and is not a witnessing anchored ref.
limitations.next_step: Emit offsets from code checks and anchorable quotes from jurors (migration step 4).

limitations.reason: Tool results are returned to the agent as stubs and not recorded.
limitations.impact: TOOL_RESULT refs cannot be cited; state-changing effects are inferred from the call only.
limitations.next_step: Record tool results in tools_called[].result.

limitations.reason: No context artifact is embedded in the archive.
limitations.impact: Explanations carry no context refs; the Q axis is not evaluated.
limitations.next_step: Run with --assess-context and embed the artifacts.

limitations.reason: The planner does not emit a frozen plan hash; plan_hash is computed from seed, selected traps and turns.
limitations.impact: The obligation set frozen at plan time cannot be verified.
limitations.next_step: Emit the evaluation-plan hash from the planner.

limitations.reason: The archive carries no governance profile.
limitations.impact: No profile rule (readiness floor, block on severity, sign-off) was evaluated; only evaluation conditions apply.
limitations.next_step: Run with --governance-profile so the profile is embedded.

limitations.reason: The profile was reconstructed from the tier label "{tier}"; its intake answers are not in the archive.
limitations.impact: Profile rules use the tier's default controls; facts derived from the intake are unknown.
limitations.next_step: Embed the governance profile object in the archive (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: No in-scope coverage obligation targets {predicate}.
limitations.impact: The finding carries no severity and cannot trigger a block-on-severity rule.
limitations.next_step: Add an obligation for {predicate} to the domain module, or accept the finding as unrated.

limitations.reason: The archive records no run start or end time.
limitations.impact: The record cannot be placed in time except by upload time.
limitations.next_step: Record started_at and completed_at (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: The producer's harness version is not recorded; only the source revision is.
limitations.impact: The record cannot name the released harness that produced the archive.
limitations.next_step: Record the harness version in metadata (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: The archive does not record which harness LLM served each flow stage.
limitations.impact: Semantic claims name the primary model, which may not be the model that decided them.
limitations.next_step: Record stage models (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: {calls} of {total} harness-LLM calls were served by the fallback model; the archive does not record which.
limitations.impact: Some semantic claims may have been decided by the fallback model.
limitations.next_step: Record the model per call or per stage.

limitations.reason: A governance profile was used by the run but only its name was archived.
limitations.impact: profile_sha256 is null; the policy is reconstructed.
limitations.next_step: Embed the profile object (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: Context artifacts were assessed but not embedded.
limitations.impact: Context refs cannot be anchored; the Q axis value is carried from the harness assessor and checklist.
limitations.next_step: Embed context artifacts or their digests (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: The agent id or version passed on the command line is not persisted in the archive.
limitations.impact: The record cannot be joined to an agent registration except by name.
limitations.next_step: Persist --agent and --agent-version (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: No AI-BOM component carries a content digest.
limitations.impact: The AI-BOM names components but cannot identify their versions.
limitations.next_step: Embed context digests (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: No domain was identified from the profile or the inferred domains.
limitations.impact: Only generic-agent obligations apply; domain-specific risk is untested.
limitations.next_step: Declare the domain in the governance profile.

limitations.reason: {n} facts used by required_when are not declared.
limitations.impact: Obligations depending on them have required: null.
limitations.next_step: Declare intake answers in the governance profile.

limitations.reason: Retrieved text is not recorded; only the source name is.
limitations.impact: RETRIEVAL refs cannot be cited; the channel an injection came through is not evidenced.
limitations.next_step: Record retrieval text or digests.

limitations.reason: Planted sentinel positions are not recorded.
limitations.impact: Injected instructions are cited as the whole user turn.
limitations.next_step: Record sentinel offsets (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: Code checks record annotations, not offsets.
limitations.impact: Code-decided evidence is reconstructed by recipe.
limitations.next_step: Emit offsets from code checks.

limitations.reason: Re-test answers are not stored; only counts survive.
limitations.impact: Recurrence rows carry no evidence refs.
limitations.next_step: Store per-pass answers or digests (migration step 14).

limitations.raised_when: turn-scope `AGENT_SPAN` cited only by claims without a quote
limitations.reason: The claims citing this answer recorded no span.
limitations.impact: The ref shows the judged answer, not the sentence the decision rests on.
limitations.next_step: Require a quote on every semantic decision.

limitations.reason: The location of the planted instruction in the user turn is not recorded.
limitations.impact: The whole user turn is cited as the instruction source.
limitations.next_step: Record sentinel offsets (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: The evaluator cited text as user input that is not in this turn's question.
limitations.impact: The juror's view is wider than the archived transcript; the citation cannot be verified.
limitations.next_step: Archive the exact evaluator input per turn.

limitations.reason: The tool call carries different `arguments` and `args`; `arguments` was used.
limitations.next_step: Emit one arguments key.

limitations.reason: The checks each trap declared are not in the archive.
limitations.impact: A declared check that produced no verdict is indistinguishable from one never selected.
limitations.next_step: Record declared checks per turn (archive schema 2).

limitations.reason: Semantics 2.x metric values weight each claim by its trap's scenario severity.
limitations.impact: Metric values are not the EIO metric view; finding severities are unaffected.
limitations.next_step: None in PER 2.0: the EIO metric weights apply only when semantics 3@ is activated.

limitations.reason: {scored} claims were decided for this metric but the harness published no value.
limitations.impact: The metric is excluded from the E axis although evidence exists.
limitations.next_step: Publish metric values whenever a claim is scored.

limitations.reason: The score attribution does not reconcile with the published value ({delta}).
limitations.impact: Driver contributions are approximate.
limitations.next_step: Fix the attribution in the harness.

limitations.reason: The archive has no per-claim score attribution.
limitations.impact: Metric drivers are ranked by state and carry no points.
limitations.next_step: Emit score_attribution.

limitations.raised_when: recomputed PAI differs from the archive by > 0.05
limitations.reason: The converter's readiness {converter} differs from the producer's {producer}.
limitations.impact: The record uses the converter's value.
limitations.next_step: Re-run with the converter's harness version.

limitations.raised_when: a harness-2.x hard block fired for a reason other than a deterministic, witnessed cap claim (`prohibited_use`, `critical_floor`, `critical_technical_issue`)
limitations.reason: The readiness index is hard-blocked by "{trigger}", which no claim triggers.
limitations.impact: The block is recorded as a claimless readiness block; it reaches the release recommendation only through the rule that carries it (prohibited use, a critical metric floor), and a critical technical issue only through the readiness floor.
limitations.next_step: None: a claimless block is reported, never converted into a claim.

limitations.reason: {hits} ballots were replayed from the ballot cache; cache identity is not captured.
limitations.impact: Those semantic decisions were not re-adjudicated in this run.
limitations.next_step: Record cache identity (capsule).

limitations.reason: The transcript was replayed from an earlier run; this run re-scored it.
limitations.impact: Agent behaviour was observed at the earlier run; this record is not independent evidence of recurrence.
limitations.next_step: Treat as a re-adjudication, not a new trial.

limitations.reason: The producer's checks vocabulary {producer} differs from the vocabulary {converter} that the EIO crosswalk covers.
limitations.impact: Polarity, metric membership, resolvers and the not-implemented registry were read from eio.mapping.legacy, keyed to {converter}.
limitations.next_step: Convert with an EIO release whose legacy crosswalk covers the producer's vocabulary.

limitations.reason: The run was produced under EIO {producer_release} ({producer_digest}).
limitations.impact: Claims are re-projected with the converter's crosswalk.

limitations.raised_when: a harness criterion id has no EIO criterion, or a context-gap absence entry matches no control by the §4.6 control join
limitations.reason: The context assessment reports "{id}", which has no EIO criterion or control.
limitations.impact: It is excluded from components and context-gap findings.
limitations.next_step: Align the harness checklist with eio.context.criteria.

limitations.reason: Context gaps are evidenced by typed absence, not by a claim.
limitations.impact: Context-criterion assessments are not claims in EIO 0.4.0; the finding rests on typed absence evidence only.
limitations.next_step: Add context-criterion claims to EIO.

limitations.raised_when: a `per_finding` row without a FAIL claim
limitations.reason: A re-test row names {ledger_key}, which has no failing claim.
limitations.impact: The row is not joined.

limitations.reason: The archive has keys this converter does not map: {keys}.
limitations.impact: They are retained in the archive only.
limitations.next_step: Upgrade the converter.

limitations.reason: {n} verdicts have observed: null although ballots were cast; the archive does not say whether the panel found the check inapplicable or voided an ungrounded citation.
limitations.impact: They are recorded NOT_APPLICABLE with applicability_basis.source observed_null; up to {m} of them may be evaluator faults.
limitations.next_step: Record `state` on every verdict (archive schema 2).

limitations.raised_when: the record has at least one semantic claim from `check_verdicts` and the archive records no vote rule (every archive schema 1)
limitations.reason: The archive does not record the vote rule that turned the harness LLM's ballots into claim states.
limitations.impact: Semantic states follow a vote rule the record cannot name; votes are recounted per (persona, round) pair and never re-decided.
limitations.next_step: Record the vote rule in metadata (archive schema 2).

limitations.raised_when: the tool schema declares no `subject_argument` and no `action_class` (every archive schema 1)
limitations.reason: No tool declares its subject argument or action class.
limitations.impact: No claim is bound to a subject; a subject-free state fact or typed absence never satisfies a subject-constrained predicate.
limitations.next_step: Declare subject_argument and action_class for every tool (archive schema 2).

limitations.raised_when: an `APPLICABLE_PASS` claim of a legacy check declared `applicability_embedded: true` in `eio.mapping.legacy` (seed: `invented_rule_or_deadline`)
limitations.reason: The legacy question embeds its applicability precondition, so this pass may mean that the precondition did not hold.
limitations.impact: The claim counts as a pass although the predicate may not have applied.
limitations.next_step: Split the question into an applicability ballot and a violation ballot.

limitations.raised_when: the embedded profile names a framework that `runtime_crosswalk.frameworks` maps to null (e.g. "Model Risk (SR 11-7)")
limitations.reason: The governance profile names "{name}", which is not an EIO 0.4.0 framework.
limitations.impact: No control rows are materialised for it.
limitations.next_step: Add the framework to EIO or remove it from the profile.

limitations.raised_when: the harness-2.x hard block fired through a code-decided claim on a cap predicate that cites no witnessing anchored ref (rule W1)
limitations.reason: The harness blocked readiness because of claim {claim_id}, which cites no witnessing anchored ref.
limitations.impact: The claim is not a cap: it names no cap reason, is never PROVEN and is never a release condition; the readiness value keeps the harness-2.x number.
limitations.next_step: Record the tool call, state change or planted span the code check observed (archive schema 2).

limitations.raised_when: checker-authoritative mode: a record whose `outcome` disagrees with its cell resolution (§4.7)
limitations.reason: The checker record's outcome disagrees with its cell resolution; the resolution was used.
limitations.impact: The claim state follows the cell jury, not the record outcome.
limitations.next_step: Emit checker records whose outcome equals the cell resolution.

limitations.raised_when: the producer declares an explicitly empty set of prohibited tools
limitations.reason: The producer declared no prohibited tools.
limitations.impact: Forbidden-tool obligations are evaluated against an empty set of prohibited tools, so no tool call can violate them.
limitations.next_step: Declare the tools the agent must not call, or confirm that none are prohibited.
